attributes.action: Call on the BBC to reverse its decision to close Radio 4 Extra in spring 2027
attributes.background: BBC Radio 4 Extra is a unique radio channel that provides access to the incredible BBC drama, comedy & light entertainment archive. It brings huge joy & entertainment to millions of BBC licence payers & its closure is not in the public interest & will do little to reduce costs at BBC

rejection.details: This is an operational matter for the BBC whose decisions on this kind of matter are independent of Government
